articles.summary: WARSAW, N.Y., Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Financial Institutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISI) (the “Company”), the parent company of Five Star Bank and Courier Capital, LLC, will release results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 29, 2026. Management will host an earnings conference call and audio webcast on October 30, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The call will be hosted by Martin K. Birmingham, President and Chief Executive Officer, and W. Jack Plants II, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer. Within the United States, participants may access the call by dialing 1-877-425-9470 and requesting the “Financial Institutions, Inc. Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call.” A live webcast will also be available at https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1776786tp_key=90ac35b0c7 in listen-only mode. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company’s IR website, www.FISI-Investors.com , for at least 30 days. About
articles.title: Financial Institutions, Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
